_comment: Configuration for the SDD spec linters (check_artifacts.py, check_traceability.py).
Budgets are lines per artifact type and default to the values in the spec-driven-development
skill; override here only with a recorded reason. Waivers need a reason and are never added
for an in-flight milestone. milestone_slugs maps a relocated directory to its roadmap slug.
There is no root Makefile in this repository; list any `make <target>` an evidence row may
cite in known_make_targets, otherwise cite the underlying command.
